sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report is filed regarding fraudulent activity identified on card C08623-K2, which resulted in an unauthorized transaction of $287.50. The customer explicitly denied the transaction, and subsequent internal investigation linked the activity to device profile dp_30164. This device profile is identified as a shared fraud vector, as it is associated with multiple other cards and historical fraud cases, specifically CC-0002, CC-0009, and CC-0004. The pattern of activity is consistent with card-not-present fraud, indicating a coordinated effort to exploit the payment system. Given the connection to a known shared device profile, this case meets the criteria for mandatory reporting despite the transaction amount falling below the standard $1,000 threshold. The institution has blocked the affected card and initiated monitoring on all other cards linked to the compromised device profile to prevent further unauthorized access. We are reporting this activity to ensure regulatory compliance and to assist in the broader identification of the fraud ring utilizing this specific device identifier. No further customer contact is required as the card has been secured and the investigation is finalized.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.85 with 2 independent evidence pieces meets the confidence threshold.
